description: Transfer size of what the viewer ships, measured by scripts/perf-ratchet/measure-bundle.mjs from the build job's artifacts: brotli (quality 11, node zlib) of the engine WASM, of the viewer's main entry chunk, and of every JS file dist/index.html loads eagerly (the bytes are the blocking ceiling; the file count is a looser companion with a few chunks of headroom, #7002). Raising a ceiling is a human PR with a justification (docs/guide/performance.md, 'Perf ratchet ceilings'); lowering is the daily perf-ratchet-lower.yml job (Refs #6955).
